Description: A unique identifier assigned to specimens collected from study participants. For multi-specimen data files provide all IDs in a comma-separated list.
Level of data processing applied to file. Levels refer to pre-defined standards of processing for the given assay.
This attribute indicates the general method that needs to be used to demultiplex multispecimen raw data.
Valid Values: genotypic demux, hashtag oligos, sample barcode, slide array map

Description: The total number of events detected and captured in the corresponding FCS file. In cytometry, an event corresponds to particles detected and measured by the instrument. This number corresponds to the number of rows in the FCS file and is expected to be a whole integer number. If value unknown, enter '-1'
Standard file format name or file extension
unique identifier for a multiplexed sample that consists of multiple specimen pooled together before data collection begins.
Label assigned to experimental data files indicating whether the data contained corresponds to a single or multiple biospecimens
